topic: Preparing production launches: pre-launch checklist, monitoring setup, staged rollout planning, and rollback strategy (yubiOS skill shipping-and-launch ground source)

subtopics.scope: The six-section pre-launch checklist (code quality, security, performance, accessibility, infrastructure, documentation) as a hard launch gate, including the external standards it invokes.
seed_queries: production launch readiness checklist best practices
release readiness review checklist software engineering

subtopics.scope: Decoupling deployment from release with feature flags: the flag lifecycle (deploy off, enable team, gradual rollout, monitor, clean up) and the ownership, expiry, and nesting rules.
seed_queries: feature flag best practices lifecycle cleanup expiration
feature flags progressive delivery kill switch best practices

subtopics.scope: The six-step rollout sequence from staging to full rollout: staging tests, deploy with flag off, team enablement, canary at 5 percent, gradual 25/50/100, full rollout with a 1 week monitor.
seed_queries: canary deployment gradual rollout best practices
progressive rollout stages staging production canary percentage

subtopics.scope: The advance, hold, and roll back decision thresholds (error rate, P95 latency, client JS errors, business metrics) and the immediate roll back triggers.
seed_queries: canary analysis metric thresholds automated rollback
error rate latency rollback criteria production deployment

subtopics.scope: What to monitor at launch (application, infrastructure, client metrics), error reporting setup on client and server, and the post-launch verification routine for the first hour.
seed_queries: production monitoring golden signals observability launch
error monitoring reporting post-deploy verification best practices

subtopics.scope: Using the SLO error budget as an objective release gate: the 20 percent remaining, 0 to 20 percent, and exhausted bands, and burn rate as a hold signal during canary.
seed_queries: SRE error budget policy release gate
error budget burn rate SLO best practices

subtopics.scope: The rollback plan document: trigger conditions, rollback steps (flag off vs revert), database migration considerations, and time to rollback targets.
seed_queries: rollback strategy database migration expand contract compatibility
deployment rollback plan runbook best practices

subtopics.scope: The cultural layer: common rationalizations (works in staging, monitoring is overhead, rolling back is failure), red flags such as big bang releases and Friday deploys, and the before and after verification checklists.
seed_queries: why not deploy on friday incident risk
launch failure postmortem engineering culture checklist
